summary: The patch correctly implements ABAP indentation and line wrapping as specified. It provides `indent` and `Format` functions in `hir/abap/format.go`, routes all generated ABAP through `Format`, handles all acceptance criteria (two-space indentation, class/TRY/CASE rules, report events, literal/comment awareness, continuation lines, 255-byte wrap limit, idempotency), and passes the full test suite with no regressions.
